narration_timeline.text: Here is a North American beaver filmed in an enclosure at a zoo.
narration_timeline.scene: Real captive beaver at Ljubljana Zoo

narration_timeline.text: On dry ground, its heavy body is easy to spot as it moves along.
Watch it enter the water, where the same animal begins to paddle.
Other close recordings reveal its thick coat and broad body from new angles.
narration_timeline.scene: Real beaver body and fur close view

narration_timeline.text: Back in the pool, the beaver travels with a very different-looking movement.
narration_timeline.scene: Separate actual beaver moving in pool

narration_timeline.text: These real zoo scenes show how one animal handles both land and water.
narration_timeline.scene: Two genuine Ljubljana Zoo beaver clips
